title: Hybrid explicit tool plus threshold hook
summary: Add an explicit cartographer_compact_context extension tool for phase-end compaction and a conservative threshold hook for active Cartographer implementation contexts.

title: Additive customInstructions with default Pi compaction
summary: Use Pi's default compaction path with Cartographer-focused customInstructions rather than replacing the summarizer.

title: Gate threshold compaction to active Cartographer state
summary: Run threshold checks after turns, derive active topic from valid current state, and skip below-threshold or duplicate requests.

title: Replace Pi compaction summarizer
summary: Rejected because replacing session_before_compact is more invasive than passing additive customInstructions.

title: Automatically compact on every compact-generate
summary: Rejected as default because compact-generate is a state snapshot operation and not every snapshot should prune transcript context.

title: Cartographer tools extension
summary: extensions/cartographer-tools.ts will host the explicit compaction tool, helper functions, and optional event hooks.

title: Asynchronous compaction timing
summary: ctx.compact is asynchronous/fire-and-forget, so tool results must report queued state and avoid assuming immediate completion.
